# JEE & Board Examination PYQ Practice Portal

> An interactive, web-based examination practice platform designed for students preparing for JEE Main, JEE Advanced, and AIEEE.

## Key Features

- **Real Exam Simulations**: Full-length previous year question papers (PYQs) with official exam interfaces and timed conditions.
- **Chapter-Wise Practice**: Targeted topic-level question banks for focused revision across Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.
- **Instant Evaluation**: Detailed solution breakdowns, subject-wise scoring, and accuracy analytics.
- **Revision Tools**: Personal question bookmarking and flagged problem tracking for quick re-testing.

## Platform Routes

- [/](/): Homepage and student practice dashboard.
- [/auth/login](/auth/login): Student authentication and account sign-in.
- [/exam/login](/exam/login): Exam interface login imitation.
- [/exam/questions](/exam/questions): Solve questions of the chosen year.
- [/exam/result](/exam/result): Detailed results of the attempt.

> All `/exam/*` routes are only accessible once a specific exam year/session is selected.

## Exam Coverage

- **JEE Main**: Full shift-wise papers and past year question sets.
- **JEE Advanced**: Paper 1 & Paper 2 previous year questions.
- **AIEEE**: Legacy AIEEE exam question archives.
